title: Gold Rush
description: Parker's team tries a wild plan to resupply their water; Tony struggles with a rock truck driver; Rick gets test results on his Snake River cut.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description: A windstorm near Salt Lake City overturns a semi with a mystery load; a hauler with a heavy-duty load of data center cooling units spins out of control on I-80; Mountain Recovery's rookie operator fights a multi-front battle as a midwinter storm hits.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description: In Arizona, a scientist turned miner gambles his retirement to secure a legacy for his son; against logic, Freddy and Juan must turn up the heat to fix the miner's innovative, self-designed dry washer to save the mine.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description: Freddy and Juan help a retired couple make a success of their mine; they take on one of their toughest wash plant rebuilds and the worst clay problem they've seen.

title: Gold Rush: White Water
description: A darkness descends on Nugget Creek as mine boss Dustin searches for a plan B; his crew may be onto something at their new mine site; after battling bedrock for months, a breakthrough offers them the hope they need.

title: Along Central Asia's Great Rivers
description: High in the mountains of Kyrgyzstan, Kate locates the source of the Syr Darya, the longest river in the region; she follows the great river towards the Fergana Valley.

title: Live to Farm
description: The family travels to Brazil to get a taste of how sugarcane is grown; Spraytec hosts a visit to some beautiful crop farms.

title: MythBusters
description: Testing Hollywood car crimes; a cliff-top push; two-wheel wipeout; the Corvette barrel roll from "Wanted.".

title: MythBusters
description: The team tests YouTube myths; giant ball of Legos; the explosive power of match heads.

title: MythBusters
description: Adam and Jamie tackle fan favorites; video games; grenades; spy cars; superfast firearms.

title: MythBusters
description: Testing the hijinks from the "Indiana Jones" franchise.

title: MythBusters
description: The team joins forces, placing popular sayings under the microscope to determine whether it really is "impossible to polish a turd," possible to "hit the ground running" or advisable to "end with a bang.".

title: MythBusters
description: Adam and Jamie test whether it's better to keep windows open or closed during a hurricane; liquid nitrogen.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description: When Hurricane Harvey hit Texas with 130 mph winds and record-breaking rain, cameras captured catastrophic flooding as entire neighborhoods vanished, forcing civilians to risk their own lives to save others in one of the costliest disasters in US history.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description: In 2024, as a monster storm system unleashes a record-breaking derecho across Texas, eyewitnesses capture multiple destructive tornadoes on camera; when one twister targets a remote farmhouse, a weather spotter must race to save a young family.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description: Cameras capture the unfolding disaster as a powerful EF-4 tornado devastates Mayfield, leveling the courthouse, police headquarters and jail where officers race to rescue trapped inmates while preventing escape.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description: When a rare EF-3 tornado touches down in northern Michigan, cameras capture the chaos and disbelief.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description: Tourists and locals endure catastrophic winds and flooding as Category 5 Hurricane Melissa tears across Jamaica; as guests scramble to take shelter, resorts in Montego Bay suffer structural failure, while torrential rain inundates the town of Black River.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description: A rare, powerful weather system races 1,000 miles across the Great Lakes, unleashing damaging tornadoes in Canada's capital city, Ottawa. With no warning, residents scramble for safety as the monster storm tears apart apartment blocks and power stations.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description: Four unique weddings in one day stretch the Golden Nugget's wedding team to their limit; a crack in the 200,000-gallon shark tank raises the alarm; stolen casino keys cause chaos; security breaks up a rowdy wedding party of seniors.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description: Reports of loud bangs and bullet holes on the eighth floor spark a tense night before the cause of the chaos is discovered one floor above; a VIP host loses her most valuable client and puts all her hopes of making her monthly quota on a walk-in whale.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description: A big music festival takes over Las Vegas and brings nearly-naked guests, packed rooms and non-stop partying to the Nugget; a disturbance call in the hotel sparks tension between guests as a desperate chip thief risks returning to the casino to cash in.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description: A rookie security manager on his first graveyard shift struggles to keep up with an escalating barrage of bizarre calls, ringing one after another; meanwhile, a late-night VIP pickup turns into a cross-town odyssey full of unexpected detours.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description: A hotel guest reports a theft that launches an investigation with security and Metro detectives, but the truth proves to be far more scandalous; meanwhile, VIP hosts risk big money on a supercar event and scramble to hit a make-or-break attendance goal.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description: As the first weekend of the busy season kicks off at the Golden Nugget, a missing $1,000 chip sparks a high-tech and hotel-wide hunt to find the person who took it; gaming surveillance cracks down on a team of card counters hitting Fremont Street casinos; tempers flare at the hotel check-in line and a confrontation puts security on alert and a VIP host pulls strings to keep a high roller happy and gambling after he goes on a six-figure winning streak.

description: Parker strikes gold in Bolivia at a location that could be the next Klondike; with time running out on his prospect, Parker faces a big decision.

description: Former "Gold Rush" miner Dave Turin sets out on his own prospecting for an abandoned gold mine to reopen; when an investor backs out, Dave has to decide if he's willing to risk his family's life savings on his ability to bring home the gold.

description: When their hillbilly scotch experiment flames out, Mark and Digger light a fire under their still hand, Kelly. Josh's lucrative 80-gallon moonshine order rides on Jerry's unproven vacuum still experiment. Mike devises a recipe to poach Jerry's buyer.

title: Moonshiners
description: For America's 250th anniversary, Tim and Tickle produce revolutionary-era moonshine; Digger questions Mark's attempt at his ancestor's sour corn whiskey; Josh and Jerry's plans fail.

title: Guided: The Reel Story of Louisiana Guides
description: Science, saltwater and sportsmen; our friends at Louisiana Wildlife and Fisheries take us on a guided tour aboard the stingray -- the state's new saltwater electrofishing boat -- to show how cutting-edge science helps manage the fish that guides and anglers depend on.

title: Tomorrow's World Today
description: George sends Greg to the World of Production to uncover how cutting-edge automotive glass engineering is transforming modern vehicles and powering tomorrow's mobility marvels.

description: A new officer makes one of the biggest drug busts her bridge has ever seen; a group of biology students returning from Mexico is carrying something unexpected in their trunk; a pedestrian attempts to conceal something valuable under his clothing.

description: A truck carrying household goods into Mexico is stopped for inspection; when several boxes are X-rayed, a gun and ammunition are found hidden inside a kids' toy box; a man re-entering the U.S. is stopped after checks reveal he is wanted for murder.

description: Officers investigate a man crossing with a statue of Santa Muerte, deemed the patron saint of drug smugglers; a band's tour bus is flagged when an X-ray reveals a dark object in its fuel tank; a K9 alerts to the car of a felonious traveler.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description: Officers target SUVs that are notorious for concealing drugs; two wanted cartel members are extradited back to Mexico; officers struggle to open up an engine part that they think is hiding drugs; a woman smuggling diet pills is caught in the act.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description: Officers spot a lone pedestrian entering the U.S. with large bags; the search reveals containers of coffee, one concealing a package of suspected narcotics; the x-ray of a flatbed trailer reveals hidden bundles, but officers struggle to reach them.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description: When an older couple crossing into the US has cartel logos on their packed clothes, they have some explaining to do; a Mexican driver says he's visiting a friend in Texas, but seems nervous; a vehicle search finds evidence of hidden compartments.

title: Naked and Afraid: Last One Standing
description: In the Australian Outback, 14 of "Naked and Afraid's" best, including Laura, Matt, Ky and Max, vie for the title.
